# Fatorati — robots.txt
# https://fatorati.tech

# Default: allow everything except the admin CMS (also enforced via the
# X-Robots-Tag response header in public/_headers and a noindex meta tag
# rendered while /admin is mounted, in src/admin/AdminLayout.tsx — three
# independent layers so it stays out of results even for a crawler that
# only honors one of the three).
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
